placements.why: Establishes the organizational strategy category for system resilience, recovery procedures, and operational readiness.
placements.title: System resilience, operational recovery, and fault tolerance
placements.frame: How does the organization ensure operational recovery readiness, fault tolerance, and system resilience?

placements.title: Recovery mechanisms constitute genuine operational capability only when routinely rehearsed
placements.frame: Does the expression treat operational recovery procedures and rollbacks as non-existent unless verified through regular rehearsal?
placements.why: Captures the directive establishing monthly Atlas rollback drills alongside the core principle that an unrehearsed rollback procedure does not constitute an actual operational capability.
